utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's this about a repair drive for the neighborhood?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I just heard something about it from Deb at the store. Something about fixing up the park benches, I think.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Park benches? Which ones, the ones by the oak tree?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, need any tools for the repair drive this weekend? I've got a full shed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think I might be okay, but let me check my list — I can never remember what I've got.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, take your time. Just let me know if you need anything—I'm happy to lend it out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, did you hear about the repair drive happening this weekend? They're fixing up old bikes for the kids.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that sounds nice, but where exactly is it happening? And do they have enough tools and volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It's at the community center on Elm Street, starting at 10 AM. I heard they're a bit short on tools, so I'm planning to bring my wrench set. Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Opal, is there anything you need help with for the repair drive? I've got some free time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually, could you help me check the addresses for the tool drop-off points? I want to make sure we have the right locations.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that. Do you have a list of the addresses?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up old electronics and furniture—bring anything broken!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, I... I might have a small radio that's broken. I'll think about it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! A radio's perfect for beginners—we can teach you a thing or two! See you there?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo! I'm glad we can chat about the repair drive. How can we coordinate to make it a success?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let's meet at the community center tomorrow at 6 PM to assign tasks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds perfect! I'll bring a list of available volunteers and tools we can use.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you clarify what you mean by the repair drive? I want to make sure I understand correctly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, sorry I'm late. What's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I was just asking about the repair drive you mentioned earlier—I want to make sure I understand what it is.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Mara, have you heard about the repair drive at the school? I was thinking of helping organize it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great, Faye! I'd love to help out. What can I do?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Maybe you could help me sort the donated items? I'll need a hand with that.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi, I'm Nell. I've just moved in, and I heard something about a repair drive? Can you tell me more?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, hi Nell! Welcome to the neighborhood! The repair drive is a community event where we fix up old items together—everything from bikes to toasters. It's this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great! I have an old lamp that needs fixing—can I bring that?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard about it. What's the deal?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure it's legit? Heard some rumors about them not actually fixing things.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hmm, well, I just heard they were collecting broken electronics. Figured it was a good thing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I've been wondering about the repair drive—how's it coming along?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think it's going... somewhere. I might've left the instructions in my garage, actually.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Want me to help you look for it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Cleo, did you hear? The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I heard! I've been stocking up on spare parts all week. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It starts at 10 AM and runs until 4 PM. I'll be there early helping set up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, any updates on the repair drive? I heard you were organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, it's coming along slowly. I could use a hand if you're free later.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I've got some time this afternoon. What do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I forgot what that is again. Could you remind me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 10am to 4pm. We're fixing up old electronics and furniture together!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, right! I remember now. Can I bring my broken toaster?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think I heard something about that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, it's happening this weekend. You need anything fixed?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, let me think... I can't quite recall if anything's broken. Maybe I'll just come by and see.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Eli, I heard about the repair drive. I've got a bunch of tools if you need to borrow any.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's mighty generous, Gus. I like to have things organized—do you have a list of what you're offering?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I've got a list in my head—spades, hammers, wrenches, you name it. Want me to write it down?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Quinn, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely! I've already told a bunch of people. It's going to be a great turnout!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's wonderful, Quinn! I'm glad you're spreading the word. Do you need any help organizing supplies or tasks?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal! How's the repair drive coming along?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's going smoothly—just finished the alignment check on the south end.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great to hear! The south end was looking a bit off, glad it's fixed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hello Cleo! I'm so glad we're finally organizing this repair drive. How can I help you get involved?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Well, Rosa, I've been keeping an inventory of what tools and parts folks have donated so far. Maybe we can figure out what's still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's fantastic, Cleo! I'd love to see your list — do you have it handy?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Mina, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What is that, exactly?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: It's a community event where we help each other fix things like electronics, clothes, and furniture. I heard it's this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, what's this repair drive about? I'm a bit rushed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, it's a community event to fix up old appliances and furniture. We're collecting items at the school this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I'll see if I can drop by something. Gotta go!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, are you organizing a repair drive? I'd be happy to lend a hand if you need it!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Who's behind that?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, I thought you were organizing it. Or maybe it's someone else in the neighborhood?
